draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.34, the 34th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 6th of 35 at WR. He lasted until pick 59, well after his grade rank (34th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Josh Doctson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 731 receiving yards in 2020, 15th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 43 career games and 17 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 4 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile), team target share 1.0% (8th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2024.
